title: Proper support of the algebraization candidate
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring complete for an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $P$ be a locally Noetherian scheme with a proper morphism $p:P\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $j:Y\to P$ be an open immersion. Let $F'$ and $F$ be coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent] on $P$ and $Y$, respectively, with $j^*F'\simeq F$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Assume $\operatorname{Supp}(F')\cap p^{-1}V(I)\subset j(Y)$. Then $F$ has support proper over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base].

proof.text: The coherent support C on P is closed by finite-type module support. For its closed boundary C minus j(Y), properness makes the image in Spec A closed. A nonempty such image contains a maximal ideal, which contains I by the adic-complete Jacobson-radical lemma. A point above it contradicts the given closed-fibre containment. Thus C lies inside j(Y).

The reduced induced closed subscheme of C is proper over A. Lift its inclusion uniquely through the open immersion j; the lift is closed because its composite with the separated j is closed. Its range equals the inverse image of C, identified with Supp(F) by finite-type pullback support and the restriction isomorphism. Apply the closed-subset properness criterion with this closed subscheme structure.

lean.statement: theorem chow_algebraization_candidate_support (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A] {P Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian P] (p : P ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper p] (j : Y ⟶ P) [IsOpenImmersion j] (F' : CoherentModules P) (F : CoherentModules Y) (eF : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j).obj F'.obj ≅ F.obj) (hSupport : {x : P | ¬ Subsingleton (F'.obj.presheaf.stalk x)} ∩ p ⁻¹' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ⊆ Set.range j) : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver (j ≫ p) F.obj
